'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title RAITHIR'S NOT GERMANY FOR NOTHING. Starts with [[Drop! (V)]]. Captain Brewel → [[Captain Bewil (V)]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
